claims.evidence: All three photos clearly show the engraved label 'AF-S NIKKOR 50mm 1.8G', not 60mm.
No import markings, serial number, or documentation visible in any photo to confirm origin.
Photos only show the rear mount and exterior on bubble wrap; no clear shot of front/rear glass, barrel scratches, or optical clarity.

risks.risk: Optical condition: fungus, haze, dust, or scratches inside the lens elements
risks.proof: A photo of the lens held up to light showing front and rear glass clearly, or a video panning through the glass
risks.if_unproven: priced as has visible optical defects

risks.risk: Autofocus motor and aperture blade functionality
risks.proof: A video clip showing the lens mounted on a camera body, cycling focus and aperture
A close-up photo of the rear mount contacts and bayonet ring for dents or corrosion

risks.risk: Whether one or two lenses are included in this sale
risks.proof: Seller statement or photo clearly indicating quantity being sold, matched to the listing
risks.if_unproven: priced as a single lens only

risks.risk: Missing original box, caps, hood, or documentation
risks.proof: A photo of the included accessories laid out together
risks.if_unproven: priced as bare lens with no accessories

risks.proof: A clear photo of the full barrel engraving or the lens barcode/serial confirming the actual focal length and version
risks.if_unproven: priced strictly as the 50mm 1.8G shown in photos, ignoring the 60mm claim

proof_requests: Clear photo of front and rear glass elements under light
Video of lens mounted on a camera, showing autofocus and aperture operation
Close-up of rear mount contacts and bayonet ring
Confirmation and photo of exactly how many lenses are included in this sale
Photo of any included box, caps, hood, and documentation
Full barrel engraving photo or serial number to resolve the 50mm/60mm discrepancy
response.reason: The witness clearly identifies a Nikon AF-S NIKKOR 50mm 1.8G lens, so it can be priced at worst case despite the seller's unsupported condition claims and the contradicted 60mm label.
